scope: Local in-process synthetic-fixture microbenchmarks only. No network, AI-provider, database, browser, or Homesolo measurements. Timing is machine-specific and is not a claim of competitive superiority.

warnings: Retrospective descriptive metrics, not evidence of causal improvement or guaranteed future accuracy.
Closed-sale outcomes are selected observations: unsold, withdrawn, missing, and unlicensed outcomes can create selection and survivorship bias.
Use a prospectively frozen cohort, time-based holdouts, market/price-band stratification, missing-outcome accounting, and a paired baseline before claiming improvement.
Repeated forecasts of the same property are dependent observations; evaluate one prespecified forecast per property or use property-clustered analysis.
Range coverage describes an empirical comparable envelope, not calibrated confidence-interval coverage.
Synthetic demo outcomes test evaluation plumbing only; they cannot validate market accuracy.
Fewer than 30 evaluable observations; do not infer statistical calibration or comparative superiority from this sample.

missingBenchmarks: AI factual grounding against a human-adjudicated question set
Live integration freshness and error rates
Database and storage performance under concurrent tenant load
